'''Garouf Lafoe''' was a [[human]] from [[Tatooine]]. A patron of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]], he was present in the [[Cantina|bar]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] were forced into a brawl with [[Ponda Baba]] and [[Cornelius Evazan]]. Having witnessed Kenobi using a [[Jedi]]'s [[lightsaber]] to cut Baba's right [[Limb|arm]], Lafoe exited the cantina and informed a [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtrooper]] unit leader of the incident.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garouf Lafoe first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" />
